description.value: Baoguette Vietnamese Bistro is a sit-down Vietnamese restaurant in Richmond offering authentic dishes including bánh mì, pho, spring rolls, and noodle soups prepared with traditional flavours. The Richmond location is one of two Metro Vancouver outposts, with online ordering available. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond's busy No. 3 Road corridor could stop here for a filling bowl of pho or a banh mi to go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Vietnamese restaurant at #105-4800 No. 3 Rd, Richmond with phone 604 279 5168, matching the OSM address. The menu page explicitly notes 'Only large size for take out,' confirming takeout service. No website content addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so those are all null.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; Richmond phone 604-279-5168 sourced from website only.
Business operates two locations (Richmond and Kerrisdale/Vancouver); this record covers the Richmond location only — a separate OSM node may exist for the Kerrisdale location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active restaurant useful as a food stop for touring cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify these before listing.
